summary: Iteration 3 verification of UAT Text Comparator: paragraph leaf-block consolidation, placement detection, word-level inline diff, image rendered flag. Backend pytest suite extended from 14 -> 23 tests, all passing. Full frontend E2E on the public preview URL (compare run with tos_v2 pair, body/images tabs, placement badges, emerald word highlighting) plus regression of exports, history, glossary, batch and PRD download - all passing.

minor.issue: images score is 0% and the single image row is status=mismatch because tos_v2.docx contains NO image while tos_v2.eml renders logo.png/'Google Logo'. rendered=true and rendered_label='Google Logo' are correct, but the sample pair cannot exercise a true image match; overall score therefore caps at 90.00%. Consider adding an image to make_sample_v2.py's DOCX.

issues: Non-standard Tailwind class 'break-anywhere' used (v3 has break-words/break-all) - likely a no-op; verify long-token wrapping.

Trailing space is emitted per-word using index of the full words array while non-visible tokens render null, so a hidden trailing token can drop a space between adjacent words in rare mixed del/add runs.

action_items: Optional: add an image to tos_v2.docx in make_sample_v2.py so the image section can score >0 and demonstrate rendered/alt matching end-to-end.
Optional: replace 'break-anywhere' with a valid Tailwind wrapping class in DiffReport.jsx WordStream/DiffRow.
critical_code_review_comments: comparator._leaf_blocks dedupes blocks by lowercased text - two legitimately identical paragraphs in an email would be collapsed into one and reported as a missing paragraph. Acceptable today but worth noting.
compare_paragraphs uses a greedy first-come best match; a highly similar earlier paragraph can consume the best output candidate. Fine for current samples.
seed_data_creation: Compare runs saved to history were tracked and deleted by the session cleanup fixture. A glossary rule accidentally edited during UI regression was restored to [{Hi,Hey},{Hi,Hello}].
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py now has TestV2Paragraphs (9-row count, row fields, placement swap of the two paragraphs, strikethrough exclusion on row 1, image rendered flag, report shape) and TestUnitLevel (word diff Terms of Service->Terms of Use, unrendered image row). Verified body rows = 9 for tos_v2 pair; rows 7 and 8 are placement='incorrect'/status='warning'/text_match=true/similarity=1.0; remaining 7 are placement='correct'. Frontend: diff-body-0..8 exist, diff-body-7-placement & diff-body-8-placement show 'Placement Incorrect', 7 'Placement OK' badges, 60 emerald spans in diff-body-0, images tab shows 'logo.png / alt: Google Logo'.
rca_of_the_issue: No defects found this iteration. The only observation (images 0%) is a sample-data gap: tos_v2.docx has no media parts (verified via zipfile - no word/media entries), so the EML logo becomes an output-only extra row.
